question: Best Chinese AI Company end of September?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the company that owns the model that has the highest arena rank among primarily Chinese companies, based on the arena.ai Text Arena (Overall) when the table under the "Leaderboard" tab is checked on September 30, 2026, 12:00 PM ET.

Chinese Companies include but are not limited to Alibaba, Moonshot, Baidu, Z.ai, Xiaomi, DeepSeek, ByteDance, MiniMax, Meituan, Tencent, and StepFun. Companies not headquartered in China or not primarily owned or operating within the Chinese technology ecosystem are not considered primarily Chinese.

Results from the "Rank" column under the "Text Arena | Overall" Leaderboard tab at https://arena.ai/leaderboard/text/overall-no-style-control with style control off (Adjustments: None) and filtered for "Models" will be used to resolve this market.

Qualifying Chinese Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie still remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Meituan” would be ranked ahead of “Xiaomi”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking.

The resolution source for this market is the arena.ai Text Arena (Overall). If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and will resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve to "Other".

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
I found enough to brief you, but with one important gap: the leaderboard that decides this question is blocked to me, so the current leader on that exact board is unconfirmed. Several of my sources are aggregators or blogs whose numbers don't always agree. I left out anything published after 2026-09-14.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-09-14: I could not open the resolution page (https://arena.ai/leaderboard/text/overall-no-style-control returned HTTP 403). So I can't confirm the current rank of any Chinese model on that board, with style control off. [arena.ai](https://arena.ai/leaderboard/text/overall-no-style-control)
- 2026-09-02: A third-party copy of the Arena Text leaderboard probably shows the default view, with style control on, not the board used to resolve this market. Its top Chinese models are:

| Rank | Model | Company | Score |
|---|---|---|---|
| #10 | kimi-k3-max | Moonshot | 1489±5 |
| #17 | glm-5.3-max | Z.ai | 1482±7 |
| #20 | qwen3.8-max | Alibaba | 1479±6 |
| #39 | mimo-v2.5-pro | Xiaomi | 1468±4 |
| #40 | ernie-5.1 | Baidu | 1468±5 |
| #50 | deepseek-v4-pro-high-20260813 | DeepSeek | 1459±8 |

  The page itself warns that the confidence intervals overlap a lot. [superpowers-skills](https://superpowers-skills.com/en-us/2026/09/02/ai-model-leaderboards-2026.html)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The top three Chinese labs (Moonshot, Z.ai, Alibaba) are within about 10 points of each other on the 2 September snapshot.
- Rankings with style control off can differ a lot from the default view. Alibaba won the July and August versions of this market (see section 4), even though Moonshot led the default view on 2 September.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-10: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash was released, according to an aggregator. I found no Arena text rank for it. [okamomedia](https://llm.okamomedia.tokyo/en/china-ai/)
- 2026-08-26: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Flash, and Qwen 4 is reportedly only at preview or training stage. [okamomedia](https://llm.okamomedia.tokyo/en/china-ai/), [grandlinux](https://www.grandlinux.com/en/blogs/china-ai-update-september-2569.html)
- 2026-08-14: Z.ai (Zhipu) launched GLM-5.3. [boostrail](https://www.boostrail.com/blog/chinese-ai-models-2026/)
- 2026-08-03: Alibaba launched Qwen3.8-Max. Alibaba and the press reported it debuted 5th on Text Arena (the top Chinese model at the time) and 2nd on Vision Arena. These were vendor-reported figures, and that view probably had style control on. [Alibaba](https://home.alibabagroup.com/document-2021044032125272064), [DeepLearning.AI](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/qwen3-8-max-lands-with-a-bang)
- 2026-07-16: Moonshot launched Kimi K3. It debuted 1st on Arena's Frontend Code board, and a test version ("Kivine") was seen on Arena beforehand. [TestingCatalog](https://www.testingcatalog.com/early-look-at-kimi-k3-generations-from-moonshot-ai-on-arena.md), [techsy](https://techsy.io/en/blog/kimi-k3-review)
- Xiaomi: MiMo-V2.5-Pro was about #39 on the 2 September snapshot. I found no announced Xiaomi text model dated on or before 14 September.

## 4. Base rates
- July 2026 market: Alibaba was shown at 100% on 2026-08-01, after the market closed, which suggests Alibaba won. [predscope](https://predscope.com/event/best-chinese-ai-company-end-of-july)
- August 2026 market: an aggregator reports it resolved to Alibaba on 2026-09-01. Note that the page carries mismatched Kalshi rule text. [prediction.com](https://prediction.com/odds/best-chinese-ai-company-end-of-august/28319)
- Alibaba has won at least the last two monthly markets. A single new Chinese release can still change the leader within weeks, as Qwen3.8-Max did in early August.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Before or during August, Polymarket's August market had Alibaba at about 63-66%, Moonshot about 20-24%, Z.ai about 7% and DeepSeek about 5%. [cryptoslate](https://cryptoslate.com/predictions/market/best-chinese-ai-company-end-of-august/), [polymarkets.co.il](https://polymarkets.co.il/en/market/best-chinese-ai-company-end-of-august-20260717004241592/)
- For July, Kalshi's market showed Alibaba at 69% and Moonshot at 27%. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxchinaai/top-chinese-ai/kxchinaai-26jul31)
- For the September market, mirror snapshots that seem to date from late July show Alibaba at about 44-71%, Moonshot about 28%, DeepSeek about 18%, Z.ai about 11% and Baidu about 10%. The mirrors contradict each other, and I couldn't find a reliable price dated close to 14 September. [polymarkets.co.il](https://polymarkets.co.il/bn/market/best-chinese-ai-company-end-of-september-20260717140852824/)

## 6. Upcoming events before 30 September
- New Chinese models that could reach the leaderboard: a Qwen 4 preview, further GLM-5.3 variants, DeepSeek V4.1 updates, and possibly a new Xiaomi MiMo generation. I couldn't confirm any of these dates from sources on or before 14 September.
- New models usually show up on Arena within days of launch, and scores move as votes accumulate.
- The check is on 2026-09-30 at 12:00 PM ET, on the board with style control off. The current order of Chinese models on that specific board is the key unknown, so it's worth checking it directly.
